specs.Supported Application: Heart Rate Monitor, Sleep Monitor, Fitness Tracker
specs.Metrics Measured: Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Blood Pressure, Calories Burned, Heart Rate, Sleep Duration
specs.Target Audience: Girls, Men, Unisex Adults, Unisex Youth, Women

features: ALL-DAY HEALTH MONITORING: Continuously track heart rate (HR), heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen saturation (SpO2), and stress levels. Stay informed about your body’s performance throughout the day.
ADVANCED SLEEP TRACKING: Get insights into your sleep patterns with a detailed analysis of sleep stages, duration, and quality. Enhance your rest and recovery with precise sleep monitoring.

FITNESS & CALORIE TRACKING: Monitor your daily activities by tracking steps, distance, and calories burned. Ideal for walking, running, and other fitness routines, this smart ring keeps you on top of your fitness goals.
SLEEK & COMFORTABLE DESIGN: Crafted from durable stainless steel with a minimalist and ergonomic design, the lightweight MYNK Smart Ring offers a comfortable fit for both men and women.
IP68 WATERPROOF RATING: Safe for water & sweat exposure, this smart ring is perfect for workouts, showers, and rainy days, ensuring uninterrupted health tracking.
EXTENDED BATTERY LIFE: Enjoy up to 6 days of usage on a single charge, allowing continuous health monitoring without frequent recharging.
COMPATIBLE WITH ANDROID & IOS: Syncs seamlessly with Smart Health and Apple Health apps for complete wellness tracking, ensuring smooth integration with your smartphone.
